sn12.53:1.2: bhikkhave, dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati.
sn12.53:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, telaṃ ca paṭicca vaṭṭiṃ ca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya.
sn12.53:2.2: tatra puriso kālena kālaṃ telaṃ āsiñceyya, vaṭṭiṃ upasaṃhareyya,
sn12.53:2.3: evaṃ hi so bhikkhave, telappadīpo tadāhāro tadupādāno ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ jaleyya.
sn12.53:2.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, saññojanīyesu dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati.
sn12.53:3.1: saññojanīyesu bhikkhave, dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati.
sn12.53:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, telaṃ ca paṭicca vaṭṭiṃ ca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya,
sn12.53:4.2: tatra puriso na kālena kālaṃ telaṃ āsiñceyya, na vaṭṭiṃ ca upasaṃhareyya,
sn12.53:4.3: evaṃ hi so bhikkhave telappadīpo purimassa ca upādānassa pariyādānā aññassa ca anupahārā anāhāro nibbāyeyya.
sn12.53:4.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, saññojanīyesu dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati.
